name: Epsilon Harmony
description: A client module to connect to Epsilon Harmony APIs.
project_description:
Developers Only 
 Integration for https://www.epsilon.com/gb/agility-harmony/ 

 This module will help you integrate with the Epsilon Harmony API's by calling pre-defined methods. For debugging purpose all the requests/responses from the API are logged in the database which are available in views.

 Currently there is integration with 3 Epsilon API's:

 
 Create a Profile Record 
 Update a Profile Record 
 Send a Real Time Message (RTM) 
 
 For any further API requests kindly raise a issue and will add them ASAP.

 D8 Project has integration with extra two API's: 

 
 Delete a Profile Record 
 Retrieve a Profile Record 
 Create List Record 
 Update List Record 
 
 See the D7 documentation at: https://www.drupal.org/docs/7/modules/epsilon-harmony-connector 

See the D8 documentation at: https://www.drupal.org/docs/8/modules/epsilon-harmony-connector
